cover_en:
Use your built-in image generation tool to EDIT the attached square mod cover (cover.jpg) and save the result as cover_new_en.png in the current directory (1254x1254 or larger, square).

Make one precise local edit in the lower-left language list. It currently has two rows: "English ✓" above "中文 ✓". Add a THIRD row directly below them that reads exactly: "Other official languages ✓". Use the same bold black sans-serif type and the same green check mark style as the two existing rows, left-aligned with them. The new row may be slightly smaller than the others if needed so that it fits on the white background without touching or covering the map; if needed, move the three rows up a little so all three fit, keeping English on top and 中文 second. Keep every row on a single line.

Preserve EVERYTHING else exactly: the title "DESCRIPTIONS FOR EVERY TILE", the four-colour Sicily map with all its borders and colours, the white background. No other text, no other changes. Spelling must be exact: "Other official languages". After saving, check the image yourself and redo it if any text is misspelled or the map was changed.
